Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, LS Pup: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4470.1 +/- 120.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 4470.1 +/- 120.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.1925 +/- 0.0157 mas (same row, RUWE 1.25), 12.2 standard errors, is not used. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 79.3 +/- 2.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, LS Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 79.3 +/- 2.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 55,169,010 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 226 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 116, Name='LS Pup', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 226 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
